exclude.why: an island runs in a browser: its test mounts a BUILT chunk (mountIsland), and Bun cannot map that chunk back to this source — its states are held by guards/island-without-states.ts and photographed by x shot --island
the container entry point: it boots the roles and lives as long as the process — bun run dev and the image exercise it
the static build's entry point: x build --target static runs it, and the budgets step weighs what it writes
